title: Small Compiler Subset Integrated Independent Compiler Pipeline
purpose: Connect the already bounded Subset 0 reader, parser, semantic resolver, BSharp IR, BSBC encoder, BSBC loader, and BSharp VM into one primary source-to-world compiler path while production Ruby components remain separate referees.

allowed: adding compiler/small_compiler_subset_pipeline.rb as the single bounded source-to-world orchestration path
making TokenizerReader produce its primary reader records without invoking the production Lexer while retaining Lexer comparison as a referee

routing the primary pipeline only through SmallCompilerSubsetParser, SmallCompilerSubsetSemanticResolver, SmallCompilerSubsetBSBCEncoder, SmallCompilerSubsetBSBCLoader, and SmallCompilerSubsetBSBCVirtualMachine
requiring exact BSharp IR, BSBC bytes, loader summary, event results, final world, and BSharp Save parity against separate production and Ruby referees
proving deterministic compile and execution replay across the dedicated v0.1.78 fixture
preserving Profiles 1 through 7 and all accepted creator-facing syntax
forbidden_until_later_approval: routing the primary pipeline through production Parser, SemanticResolver, BytecodeEmitter, BytecodeLoader, BytecodeVirtualMachine, or Runtime
routing normal BASIC# production compilation through SmallCompilerSubsetPipeline

fixture.name: v078_integrated_independent_compiler_pipeline
required_features: open close lock take object interaction

acceptance_rules: SmallCompilerSubsetPipeline must not require, instantiate, or call the production compiler, bytecode loader, bytecode VM, or Ruby runtime on its primary path.
TokenizerReader primary reader records must still work when the production Lexer constructor is disabled.
The full primary pipeline must still compile and execute when production Parser, SemanticResolver, BytecodeEmitter, BytecodeLoader, BytecodeVirtualMachine, and Runtime constructors are disabled.
Dedicated fixture BSharp IR, BSBC bytes, event results, final world, and BSharp Save document must match separate referees exactly.
Deterministic replay must produce the sealed event-result and final-world digests.
No Profile 8, new creator syntax, binary-format change, full self-hosting claim, or Ruby retirement is allowed.
